newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Eurodollar firmer, Euroyen flat at close.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Eurodollar firmer, Euroyen flat at close.

text.p: SIMEX Eurodollars were firmer and Euroyen flat at the close on Tuesday, said dealers.
Volumes were thin with most market participants sidelined ahead of the release of the Tankan report on Wednesday.
"The Euroyen market was soft in the morning but came back in the afternoon. But there is not much conviction to do anything until after the Tankan," said a dealer with an Asian futures firm.
He said the Tankan would most probably show recovery continuing in the Japanese economy but thought monetary policy was likely to remain unchanged.
December Euroyen could try the downside but should see technical support at 99.10, he said.
The December contract settled unchanged against its CME close of 99.16. Volume was 7,325 contracts.
Japanese government bonds ended little changed with September contracts at 120.62 against its open at 120.70.
Eurodollars rebounded in the afternoon session on the back of strong U.S. Treasury bonds, said dealers.
"It was down in the morning with the Dec contract at 94.06, but it came back up with the bonds in the afternoon. I think there was also some short-covering," said a dealer.
He said the market looked a bit confused with no clear trend emerging in the absence of fresh factors.
December Eurodollars were expected to range between 94.05 and 94.15 in the near term.
December contracts settled at 94.11 against its IMM close at 94.07. Volume was 10,010 contracts.
